title: Classic Pork Dumplings
description: A traditional Chinese dish, these dumplings are a staple of Chinese cuisine. They can be steamed or pan-fried, and are best served with a dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: Ground Pork
ingredients.notes: You can also use ground chicken or beef if you prefer.

ingredients.name: All-Purpose Flour
ingredients.notes: You can also use a combination of all-purpose and bread flour.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.notes: You may need to add more or less water depending on the humidity in your area.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount of salt to taste.

ingredients.name: Aromatic
ingredients.notes: You can also use ginger or leeks for added flavor.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.notes: You can use any neutral-tasting oil for frying.

ingredients.name: Dim Sum Wrappers
ingredients.notes: You can also make your own dumpling wrappers from scratch.

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, salt, and aromatic.
Mix everything together until just combined. Be careful not to overmix.
Add the water to the mixture and mix until everything is well combined.
Knead the dough for 5-10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 20 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
To cook the dumplings, bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Add the dumplings to the pot and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
